channel.title: GeoPulse. Geopolitics in brief
channel.description: Signal-first briefings on geopolitics, edited by Lavkesh Dwivedi.

item.title: U.S. slaps sanctions on Iraqi deputy oil minister over Iran
item.description: The US imposed sanctions on Iraqi deputy oil minister Ali Maarij al-Bahadli for supporting Iran. The deputy Minister, Ali Maarij al-Bahadli, "abused his government position to divert Iraqi oil in support of the Iranian regime and its terrorist proxies," State Department spokesman Tommy Pigott said.

item.title: U.S. and Iran Exchange Fire Amid a Declared Truce
item.description: Iran will respond to a US peace proposal through Pakistan. An Iranian official said that Tehran would convey its reply through Pakistan, a key mediator. Another Iranian official had earlier dismissed a reported proposal to end the war as a “list of American wishes.”.

item.title: PM Wong calls for swift ratification of ASEAN petroleum, trade agreements amid Middle East conflict
item.description: Singapore's Prime Minister Wong called for swift ratification of ASEAN petroleum and trade agreements amid the Middle East conflict. He warned Asia will be hardest hit due to its high dependence on Gulf energy supplies.

item.title: How David Attenborough’s lush imagery hid a history of colonial harm
item.description: David Attenborough's nature documentaries hid a history of colonial harm. His focus on aesthetics over politics sustained harmful myths and obscured the violent realities of modern conservation. As David Attenborough turns 100, his legacy of bringing nature’s beauty to millions remains unmatched.

item.title: US court deals fresh blow to Trump's 10% global tariff policy
item.description: A US federal court said President Trump overstepped his authority with the 10% global tariff policy. The court dealt a fresh blow to Trump's policy. A US federal court said President Donald Trump overstepped his authority when he invoked a section of a 1974 trade law to enact the 10% global tariff policy.
